//: What: npm manifest of the MTX sidecar - a separate CAP app that provisions tenants (subscribe/unsubscribe, one database container each), deploys model upgrades and accepts tenant extensions, with the rules extensions must follow (x_ prefix, allowlist).

Why: [CAP-M20] [CAP-M21] / [CAP-STAGE-09] generated by cds add multitenancy; keeps the heavy tenant lifecycle out of the app process. The extension linter reads its rules here (not from the app). Plugins that generate database artefacts (@cap-js/change-tracking triggers) must be listed here, because the sidecar deploys the tenant databases. In development the users come from the app package.json.
If missing or unlinked: No tenant can subscribe, tenant databases lack change-tracking triggers, and extensions are not validated (no x_ prefix, no allowlist).
name: procurement-stage-09-mtx
